description:
Alibaba Cloud Function Compute backed HostedToolRepository. The
        function library is the metadata source of truth: a tool's
        declaration (description, JSON Schema parameters, supported kinds)
        is read per function from its description and tags on demand — no
        ListFunctions sweep, since a function library may hold thousands of
        functions — and cached locally with a TTL. Two tool classes ride
        the same repository: the orchestration entry (Programmatic Tool
        Calling, whose description template the handler renders per
        request) and plain single-purpose functions.
